# Kova

> The self-improving AI agent — your bots, your cloud, your rules.

Kova creates skills from experience, remembers who you are, runs scheduled
routines, and drives a real terminal and browser. One agent core, every
surface: CLI, desktop app, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and 25+ more.

## Product

- [Home](https://kova-agent.neuralstudio.in): the landing page
- [Messaging](https://kova-agent.neuralstudio.in/messaging): all 29 supported chat channels
- [Privacy](https://kova-agent.neuralstudio.in/privacy): privacy policy
- [Bot Terms](https://kova-agent.neuralstudio.in/bot-terms): Discord bot terms and privacy
- [Docs](https://kova-agent.neuralstudio.in/docs): full documentation
- [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenKova/kova): source code and releases

## What Kova is

Kova is a self-improving AI agent. One core agent runs across every surface
you already use: a desktop app, a CLI, and the messaging apps you chat in
every day. It writes code, runs shell commands, controls a browser, sends
emails, schedules routines, and remembers who you are across sessions.

## Chat channels (29)

Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, iMessage, Matrix, Mattermost,
Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, LINE, Feishu/Lark, WeChat/Weixin, ClickClack,
Nextcloud Talk, Nostr, QQ Bot, Raft, Synology Chat, Tlon, Twitch, Voice Call,
WebChat, Yuanbao, Zalo, Zalo ClawBot, Zalo Personal, IRC, SMS.

## Model providers

Kova works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Nous, OpenRouter, and
local models. Bring your own keys; nothing leaves your gateway unless you
configure it to.

## Install

- macOS & Windows: one-liner `irm https://kova.neuralstudio.in/install.ps1 | iex` then `kova setup`
- Desktop installers: https://github.com/OpenKova/kova/releases
